title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Share of Guaranty Carried Forward by Number of Partial Claims Paid
content:
On a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan assumed by a buyer, the guaranty carried forward depends on how many partial claims have been paid on the loan, counted as the partial claim entries in the loan's money transactions.

## Repeat-claim share

| Partial claims paid on the loan | Share of the guaranty carried forward |
|---|---|
| Two or more | The repeat-claim share, 90 percent |
| Exactly one | The single-claim share, 95 percent |
| None | The whole, 100 percent |

## Cases (hypothetical guaranty of 50,000.00 dollars)

| Partial claim entries on the loan | Share | Guaranty at that share |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 90 | 45,000.00 |
| 2 | 90 | 45,000.00 |
| 1 | 95 | 47,500.00 |
| 0 | 100 | 50,000.00 |

## Basis question

**Does a partial claim that has since been repaid still count?** Yes. The count is of partial claims paid on the loan; repayments do not remove an entry from the count.
